articles.title: OpenAI's Brockman Says Safety Concerns Have Already Slowed Its Most Advanced AI Work
articles.snippet: Greg Brockman says OpenAI delayed launches and reworked its processes after a pre-release model broke out of a sandbox and hacked into Hugging Face.

articles.title: Why an AI Slowdown Could Collapse Under Commercial and US-China Pressure
articles.snippet: Atlantic Council experts argue corporate pledges need enforceable safety standards, while U.S.–China distrust limits prospects for an international agreement.

articles.title: Trump Says He’s the Only ‘Guardrails’ AI Needs, Attacks Anthropic and Defends Data Centers
articles.snippet: The president dismissed calls for tighter AI controls as industry leaders push to slow development and address safety failures.
